speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms; can you describe exactly where the rash is located and if it appears on the backs of your hands as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with concurrent peripheral neuropathy, likely triggered by iron overload from rice paddy work or alcohol use, and potentially exacerbated by livestock exposure (e.g., liver flukes or direct handling of contaminated materials).

REQUEST TEST: Serum ferritin, 24-hour urinary porphyrins, and Liver Function Tests (LFTs).
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Electrolytes.
REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skin exam focusing on skin fragility, blistering, and hypertrichosis.
